title: Sunday · Last Bell, nobody
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The school at 3:05 in June with no bell drawn and no one coming out. The doors shut. The man and the pup on the far sidewalk anyway, at the usual time. The strip doesn't say why.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the high school at 3:05 from across the road, the doors shut, no bell shape, no one.

image.prompt: a small-town high school seen from across a road with its doors shut and no one in sight on a June afternoon, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Shut

panels.composition: Tier 2: the man and the pup on the far sidewalk at the usual place, looking across.

image.prompt: a man and a small three-legged dog on a sidewalk looking across a road at a closed school, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Anyway

panels.composition: Tier 3: the road to the beach empty, a paper sign taped to the school's door too far to read.

image.prompt: an empty road toward a beach past a closed school with a paper sign taped to its door too far away to read, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Road

art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: Reserved whether 2020 is 2020. No bell drawn.
